name: polish-electricity-market-pse
title: Poland Electricity Prices API – PSE Day-Ahead RCE
description: Poland electricity prices (ceny energii) and grid data from the official PSE API: RCE market price, day-ahead and imbalance prices, Kompas Energetyczny, load and generation mix in 15-minute, hourly or daily rows. For analysts and AI agents (MCP). CSV, JSON, Excel.

datasets.title: Datasets
datasets.description: PSE reports to download, processed in this order. maxItems applies to all of them together.

enumTitles: RCE market energy price (rynkowa cena energii), 15 min
Balancing market settlement prices (CEN, CKOEB, CEBśr, COR), 15 min
Power system load, actual and forecast (KSE), 15 min
Generation by production type (ENTSO-E codes), 15 min

lastDays.title: Last N days
lastDays.description: Business days before dateTo (or before today) to include, used when dateFrom is empty. Without dateTo the window ends tomorrow, so day-ahead data appears once PSE publishes it (about 14:00 Europe/Warsaw).

dateFrom.title: Business date from
dateFrom.description: Inclusive business date (doba handlowa), YYYY-MM-DD. Overrides lastDays. PSE history starts on 2024-06-14.

dateTo.title: Business date to
dateTo.description: Inclusive business date, YYYY-MM-DD. Empty means tomorrow.

granularity.title: Output granularity
granularity.description: native = rows as PSE publishes them (15 min, Kompas hourly). hour and day aggregate: mean of prices and power, sum of energy, maximum Kompas level. Aggregated rows carry intervalsCount and isComplete.

maxItems.title: Max rows
maxItems.description: Maximum dataset rows and charged events in this run, across all datasets.

onlyNew.title: Only new or revised rows
onlyNew.description: Skip rows whose values were already delivered by earlier runs with the same stateKey. A PSE revision of a value is delivered again.

stateKey.title: State key
stateKey.description: Name of the remembered-rows set used by onlyNew. Use different keys for independent schedules.

maxRequestsPerSecond.title: Max requests per second
maxRequestsPerSecond.description: Rate limit for PSE requests, including retries. One request at a time.

name: polish-developer-apartment-prices
title: Poland Apartment Prices API – Developer Price Lists dane.gov.pl
description: Poland apartment and real estate prices from every developer price list on dane.gov.pl (ceny mieszkań, jawność cen): one record per apartment or house, price per m², new/sold and price-change detection. For property analysts and AI agents (MCP). CSV, JSON, Excel.

mode.title: What to return
enumTitles: Offers: every unit in the latest price lists
Price changes: new, removed, repriced or sold units vs. the previous list
mode.description: Offers returns each unit of the newest price list of every developer dataset published in the period. Price changes compares that list with the developer's previous one and returns only differences.

lastDays.title: Published in the last N days
lastDays.description: Price lists published on dane.gov.pl in the last N×24 hours. Ignored when a date is set below. Developers republish lists daily, so 1 day already covers most active investments.

dateFrom.title: Published from (date)
dateFrom.description: First publication date, YYYY-MM-DD, Polish time. At most 14 days with dateTo.

dateTo.title: Published to (date)
dateTo.description: Last publication date, inclusive, YYYY-MM-DD, Polish time.

voivodeships.title: Voivodeships
voivodeships.description: Keep units in these voivodeships (województwa). Units whose list gives no voivodeship are dropped by this filter.

cities.title: Cities or municipalities
cities.description: Keep units whose city (miejscowość) or municipality (gmina) is one of these, e.g. Warszawa, Kraków. Case and Polish letters do not matter.

developers.title: Developer name contains
developers.description: Keep units whose developer name, price-list title or investment name contains one of these fragments, e.g. Dom Development, Murapol.

propertyTypes.title: Property types
propertyTypes.description: Parking spaces, storage and commercial units are never returned as units; they appear as add-ons of a unit. Units whose type the list does not state are kept.

onlyAvailable.title: Only available units
onlyAvailable.description: Drop units marked sold or reserved. Most lists do not state availability; those units are kept.

onlyNew.title: Only price lists not delivered before
onlyNew.description: Skip price lists this Actor already delivered in an earlier run with the same state key. Use with a daily schedule.

stateKey.title: State key
stateKey.description: Separate memory for onlyNew, e.g. one key per schedule. Letters, digits, _ and -.

maxItems.title: Max records
maxItems.description: Stop after this many records. Each record is one charged event.

maxPriceLists.title: Max price lists
maxPriceLists.description: Read at most this many developer price lists, newest first. 0 means all.

maxConcurrency.title: Parallel downloads
maxConcurrency.description: Price lists read at the same time.

maxRequestsPerSecond.title: Max requests per second
maxRequestsPerSecond.description: Politeness limit for file downloads. The dane.gov.pl API itself is always queried at 2 requests per second.

name: polish-legal-acts-eli
title: Polish Legal Acts API – Dziennik Ustaw & ELI
description: Polish law and legal acts (akty prawne) from the official Sejm ELI API: Dziennik Ustaw and Monitor Polski metadata, legal references and optional plain text. For legal research and AI agents (MCP). Export CSV, JSON or Excel.

inputSchema.title: Polish legal acts scraper input
inputSchema.description: Search the official Sejm ELI API. Without year or dateFrom the current year is searched. Text extraction prefers HTML and falls back to PDF.

publisher.title: Publication
publisher.description: DU searches Dziennik Ustaw. MP searches Monitor Polski.

year.title: Publication year
year.description: Optional publication year; defaults to the current year when dateFrom is empty. Omit it to search across years within a date range.

dateFrom.title: Start date
dateFrom.description: Inclusive lower date bound in YYYY-MM-DD format. Required when year is omitted. dateField selects the date being filtered.

dateTo.title: End date
dateTo.description: Optional inclusive upper date bound in YYYY-MM-DD format. Must be on or after dateFrom. Omit unused date fields.

dateField.title: Date to filter
dateField.description: Promulgation uses pubDateFrom/pubDateTo, announcement uses dateFrom/dateTo, and effect uses dateEffectFrom/dateEffectTo in the ELI API.

titleContains.title: Words in the title
titleContains.description: Optional title search. Polish inflection matters. Use the stem podatk for tax acts; podatek may return no matches. Omit this field for all titles.

keywords.title: Official keywords
keywords.description: Official Polish ELI subject keywords, sent as a comma-separated keyword parameter. Empty means no keyword filter.

actTypes.title: Act types
actTypes.description: Exact Polish types, for example Ustawa, Rozporządzenie, or Obwieszczenie. One type is filtered by the API. Multiple types are matched locally with OR and can require more search pages.

inForceOnly.title: Only acts in force
inForceOnly.description: Ask the ELI API to return only acts marked in force. Output inForce requires details when the search response omits it.

includeDetails.title: Include act details
includeDetails.description: Fetch each act's details for keywords, references, issuing bodies, and inForce. Adds one request per act. Disable for search metadata only.

includeText.title: Include plain text
includeText.description: Extract available HTML or PDF text. Successful text costs USD 0.008 per act. Missing or failed text costs the metadata rate of USD 0.002. No OCR is provided.

maxTextChars.title: Maximum text characters
maxTextChars.description: Zero means no user cutoff. An automatic ceiling of 8,000,000 characters and a JSON byte budget below the 9 MB dataset-item limit still apply. Positive values impose a smaller cutoff. textLength counts retained characters; textTruncated reports any truncation.

sortOrder.title: Publication position order
sortOrder.description: Newest means descending API publication position; oldest means ascending. Across years this does not guarantee chronological date order. Use year for one year's positions.

maxItems.title: Maximum output items
maxItems.description: Hard cap on delivered dataset items. Seen revisions and filtered act types do not count toward this limit.

onlyNew.title: Monitor new and changed acts
onlyNew.description: Skip previously delivered ELI plus changeDate revisions stored in a named key-value store. Retains the latest 50,000 revisions. Use serial runs for each stateKey and an overlapping publication date range to revisit changed acts.

stateKey.title: Monitoring state key
stateKey.description: Independent revision set within the named polish-legal-acts-seen store. Use 1-100 letters, digits, underscores, or hyphens. Changing this key starts a new monitoring history.

maxRequestsPerSecond.title: Maximum requests per second
maxRequestsPerSecond.description: Shared rate cap for search, details, text, and retries. Default 3 requests per second, maximum 10, with at most 2 requests in flight. Lower it during source outages.
maxRequestsPerSecond.sectionDescription: Control request pacing to the public Sejm API.

name: cee-public-tenders
title: Czech, Slovakia, Hungary & Ukraine Prozorro Tenders API – TED
description: Czech, Slovak, Hungarian and Ukrainian public tenders in one feed from official Prozorro, Slovak Vestník and TED: public procurement with CPV, value, deadline, status, only-new alerts. For B2G leads and AI agents (MCP). CSV, JSON, Excel.

countries.title: Countries
countries.description: Countries to collect. Each country is fetched from its own official source and normalized into the same schema.

lastDays.title: Published in the last N days
lastDays.description: Window of publication dates, counted back from now. Slovakia uses the date a bulletin was released as open data.

onlyOpen.title: Only tenders open for bids
onlyOpen.description: Keep only calls for competition whose submission deadline is still in the future. Turn off to also get awards, cancellations, corrections and closed tenders.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Optional. Keep tenders whose title, description or lot titles contain any of these words (case- and accent-insensitive, in the source language, e.g. software, stavba, építés, ремонт).

cpvCodes.title: CPV codes
cpvCodes.description: Optional. CPV codes or prefixes; 45000000-7 matches every code starting with 45, 7226 matches 72260000 etc. A tender matches when any of its CPV codes starts with any prefix.

includeDetails.title: Include details
includeDetails.description: Add description, lots with values and CPV codes, places of performance (NUTS or region), document and submission links and EU-funding flag. Charged as tender-with-details.

maxItems.title: Max tenders per country
maxItems.description: Upper limit of dataset items for each selected country.

onlyNew.title: Only new since last run
onlyNew.description: Skip (and do not charge) tenders already delivered by a previous run with the same state key. Use with a schedule for daily alerts.

stateKey.title: State key
stateKey.description: Name of the remembered set of delivered tenders. Use different keys for different monitors.

maxRequestsPerSecond.title: Max requests per second
maxRequestsPerSecond.description: Polite rate limit per source. Defaults to 3.

name: polish-ev-charging-stations-eipa
title: Poland EV Charging Stations API – Official EIPA
description: EV charging stations in Poland (stacje ładowania) from the official EIPA/UDT register: operator, address, GPS, kW, CCS/Type 2/CHAdeMO, live free/occupied status and prices per kWh. For apps, analysts and AI agents (MCP). CSV, JSON, Excel.

eipaToken.title: EIPA reader token
eipaToken.description: Optional: your own free EIPA reader token. Leave empty to try the Actor on its shared demo account, which all users share under EIPA's limit of 10 static downloads an hour, so it may be refused when busy. For regular or scheduled runs register an e-mail at https://eipa.udt.gov.pl/reader/register, confirm it, and paste the 32-character token (or any download link) from the e-mail EIPA sends. The Actor caches the static files in your account, so one account is enough for frequent runs.

provinces.title: Voivodeships
provinces.description: Only stations in these voivodeships. Empty = whole country.

cities.title: Cities or villages
cities.description: Only stations in these places (miejscowość), e.g. Warszawa, Kraków. Case and Polish letters do not matter.

communities.title: Communes (gmina)
communities.description: Only stations in these communes (gmina), as EIPA names them, e.g. Warszawa, Siemianowice Śląskie.

stationTypes.title: Station types
stationTypes.description: ELECTRIC = EV chargers, GAS = CNG/LNG, HYDROGEN = hydrogen. Empty = all.

operators.title: Operators
operators.description: Only stations whose operator name, short name, EIPA code (e.g. PL-GRW) or site operator contains one of these, e.g. GreenWay, Orlen, Tesla. Private operators are never matched.

connectorTypes.title: Connector types
connectorTypes.description: Only stations with at least one of these connectors. Empty = any.

minPowerKw.title: Minimum power (kW)
minPowerKw.description: Only stations with at least one point of this power or more, e.g. 50 for fast DC, 150 for high-power charging. 0 = any.

onlyAvailableNow.title: Only with a free point now
onlyAvailableNow.description: Only stations where EIPA reports at least one point operational and free at download time. Needs live data.

onlyFreeCharging.title: Only free charging
onlyFreeCharging.description: Only stations that list free charging (bezpłatne ładowanie) as a payment method.

includeLiveData.title: Include live status and prices
includeLiveData.description: Download EIPA's live file: point status (free, occupied, out of service) and ad-hoc prices. One extra download (limit 240 an hour).

privateOperators.title: Stations of private operators
privateOperators.description: Stations whose operator may be a natural person (sole traders, civil partnerships, names without a legal form). ANONYMIZE = deliver them at commune level with technical data, prices and status only (no operator, address, coordinates, codes or notes). SKIP = leave them out.

staticCacheHours.title: Reuse static data for (hours)
staticCacheHours.description: Reuse the register (operators, sites, stations, points) downloaded by an earlier run with the same token for this many hours, saving 5 of your 10 static downloads an hour. Live data is always fresh. 0 = always download.

maxItems.title: Max stations
maxItems.description: Stop after this many stations (newest registrations first). The whole register has about 7,500.

onlyNew.title: Only new or changed
onlyNew.description: Skip stations delivered by an earlier run with the same state key whose data (including live status and prices, when included) has not changed.

stateKey.title: State key
stateKey.description: Name of the memory used by 'Only new or changed'. Use a different key per schedule.

name: polish-vehicle-registrations-cepik
title: Poland Car & EV Registrations API – CEPiK Official Stats
description: CEPiK vehicle and car registrations in Poland (rejestracje pojazdów) from the official open data API: monthly counts by make, model, fuel, EV/hybrid, origin, year and region. Aggregates only, no VINs or owners. For analysts and AI agents (MCP). CSV, JSON, Excel.

monthFrom.title: From month
monthFrom.description: First month, YYYY-MM (e.g. 2026-01). Leave both months empty for the last complete month. With only From, the range runs to the current month (marked partialPeriod).

monthTo.title: To month
monthTo.description: Last month, YYYY-MM. Months are reported newest first. At most 60 months per run.

areaLevel.title: Area level
enumTitles: Poland total (sum of the selected voivodeships)
areaLevel.description: Report one total for Poland (or for the selected voivodeships together) or one block of rows per voivodeship.

voivodeships.title: Voivodeships (regions)
voivodeships.description: Default: 14 MAZOWIECKIE. Clear the field (empty list) for all of Poland (all 16 voivodeships plus records with no voivodeship, code XX); all of Poland reads 17 voivodeships and takes several minutes when CEPiK is busy.

groupBy.title: Group by

enumTitles: Powertrain: ELECTRIC, HYBRID, PETROL, DIESEL, GAS, HYDROGEN, OTHER

groupBy.description: Columns to count by. Empty = one total per month and area (fastest: counts come straight from the API without reading records).

vehicleType.title: Vehicle type
vehicleType.description: Count only this vehicle type (exact CEPiK value).

fuelType.title: Primary fuel
fuelType.description: Count only this primary fuel. Hybrids are registered with petrol or diesel as primary fuel; use groupBy powertrain to see them.

origin.title: Origin
enumTitles: New bought in poland (NOWY ZAKUPIONY W KRAJU)
Used bought in poland (UŻYW. ZAKUPIONY W KRAJU)
Entrusted by foreign entity (POJAZD POWIERZONY PRZEZ PODMIOT ZAGRANICZNY)
Bought from state services (ZAKUPIONY OD SŁUŻB)
Forfeited to state (ZAKUPIONY PO PRZEPADKU NA RZECZ SKARBU PAŃSTWA)
origin.description: Count only vehicles of this origin, e.g. new cars bought in Poland or used imports.

brand.title: Make
brand.description: Optional exact make as registered, e.g. TOYOTA (case does not matter).

model.title: Model
model.description: Optional exact model as registered, e.g. MODEL Y.

dateBasis.title: Date basis
enumTitles: First registration in Poland (new cars + imports)
dateBasis.description: Which registration date puts a vehicle in a month.

onlyCurrentlyRegistered.title: Only vehicles still registered
onlyCurrentlyRegistered.description: CEPiK's default: count only vehicles that are registered today. Turn off to include vehicles deregistered since.

topN.title: Top N rows per month and area
topN.description: Keep only the N largest groups per month and area. 0 = all groups.

maxItems.title: Max rows
maxItems.description: Hard cap of dataset rows (each row is one charged event).

onlyNew.title: Only new or changed rows
onlyNew.description: Skip rows already delivered by an earlier run with the same state key and the same count. Useful for schedules.

stateKey.title: State key
stateKey.description: Name of the remembered set of delivered rows (letters, digits, - and _).

cacheTtlHours.title: Cache lifetime (hours)
cacheTtlHours.description: Reuse breakdowns that needed more than 1,000 records and were read by an earlier run of yours within this many hours. 0 = always ask CEPiK.

maxRequestsPerSecond.title: Max requests per second
maxRequestsPerSecond.description: Politeness limit towards api.cepik.gov.pl. Requests are always sent one at a time.

name: polish-eu-funds-tenders-baza-konkurencyjnosci
title: Poland EU Funds Tenders API – Baza Konkurencyjności
description: Polish EU-funds tenders API: zapytania ofertowe (przetargi) from official Baza Konkurencyjności, procurement by EU grant beneficiaries. Filter by date, status, CPV, region, deadline; optional full details. For B2G leads and AI agents (MCP). CSV, JSON, Excel.

lastDays.title: Last N days
lastDays.description: Publication date window ending today (Europe/Warsaw), used when dateFrom and dateTo are empty. 0 means the whole archive (from 2014-01-01).

statuses.title: Announcement statuses
statuses.description: One search per status. PUBLISHED = open or awaiting result; RESOLVED = winner chosen; CANCELLED; CLOSED.

query.title: Full-text query
query.description: Words searched by the portal's own search (title and content), e.g. fotowoltaika.

category.title: Category
category.description: Order category as defined by the portal.

subcategory.title: Subcategory
subcategory.description: Optional. Must belong to the selected category.
enumTitles: Sports goods and equipment (Artykuły i sprzęt sportowy)

cpvCodes.title: CPV codes
cpvCodes.description: Exact CPV codes with check digit, e.g. 45000000-7. Matches announcements tagged with any of them.

regions.title: Place of fulfilment
regions.description: Voivodeships or Poland-wide/abroad. Matches any of them.

advertiserNip.title: Contracting entity NIP
advertiserNip.description: 10-digit Polish tax ID of the beneficiary.

onlyOpen.title: Only open for offers
onlyOpen.description: Only announcements whose submission deadline is today or later.

includeDetails.title: Include details
includeDetails.description: Fetch each announcement's details (orders, CPV, places, conditions, evaluation criteria, estimated values, projects, attachments). One extra request per item; charged as announcement-with-details.

sortOrder.title: Sort order
sortOrder.description: newest = latest publication first; deadline = by submission deadline. Order applies within each publication-date window.

maxItems.title: Max items
maxItems.description: Hard cap of dataset items (and charged events).

onlyNew.title: Only new since last run
onlyNew.description: Skip announcement IDs delivered by earlier runs with the same stateKey (not charged). Use with schedules.

stateKey.title: State key
stateKey.description: Name of the remembered-ID set; use different keys for independent feeds.

maxRequestsPerSecond.title: Max requests per second
maxRequestsPerSecond.description: Politeness limit towards the public portal, including retries.

name: polish-law-mcp-server
title: Polish Statutes & Court Rulings MCP – Dziennik Ustaw, SAOS
description: MCP server for Polish law (akty prawne, orzeczenia sądów). AI assistants search Dziennik Ustaw and Monitor Polski via Sejm ELI, read consolidated act text by article, and search and read court judgments from SAOS. Works with Claude, Cursor and other MCP clients.

inputSchema.title: Polish Law MCP Server input
inputSchema.description: This Actor is an MCP server: connect your AI client to its Standby URL ending in /mcp. A normal run executes one tool call from this input and stores the result in the dataset.

tool.title: Tool
tool.description: The MCP tool to call once.

arguments.title: Tool arguments
arguments.description: Arguments for the tool as a JSON object, exactly as an MCP client would send them. See the README for every tool's parameters.

name: polish-land-parcels-uldk-zoning
title: Poland Land Parcels API – Official ULDK Zoning
description: Polish land parcels (działki) from the official GUGiK ULDK service: location, area, boundary, plus zoning plans (MPZP) and general plan zones (POG) with building limits. Lookup by ID, precinct or GPS. No owners. For AI agents (MCP). CSV, JSON, Excel.

inputSchema.title: Poland land parcel and zoning lookup

parcelIds.title: Parcel IDs (TERYT)
parcelIds.description: Full parcel identifiers from the Polish land register (EGiB), for example 141201_1.0001.6509 or 306401_1.0051.AR_26.32. If you leave parcel IDs, names and points all empty, the Actor looks up three example parcels in the municipality of Szemud and in Mińsk Mazowiecki.

parcelNames.title: Precinct name and parcel number
parcelNames.description: A precinct (obręb) name followed by a parcel number, for example "Krzewina 134". Names repeat across Poland, so one entry can match several parcels; see 'Matches per name'.

points.title: Points (latitude, longitude)
points.description: Coordinates in decimal degrees, latitude first, for example "52.2297,21.0122" (as copied from Google Maps). Returns the parcel that contains each point.

includeZoning.title: Include zoning
includeZoning.description: Check each parcel against Rejestr Urbanistyczny: local zoning plans (MPZP) and general plan zones (POG) with building limits. Parcels with zoning found are charged as 'Parcel with zoning'.

minCoveragePct.title: Minimum coverage (%)
minCoveragePct.description: Ignore plans and zones that cover less than this share of the parcel. Plan boundaries and parcel boundaries come from different maps, so slivers below 1% are usually drawing noise.

includeGeometry.title: Include parcel boundary
includeGeometry.description: Add the parcel boundary as GeoJSON in WGS84 (longitude, latitude) to each item.

maxMatchesPerName.title: Matches per name
maxMatchesPerName.description: The most parcels returned for one 'precinct name and number' entry. Extra matches are listed in the run summary, not delivered or charged.

maxItems.title: Max parcels
maxItems.description: Hard cap on delivered (and charged) parcels in this run.

onlyNew.title: Only new or changed
onlyNew.description: Skip parcels delivered by an earlier run with the same state key unless something about them changed (for example a new local plan or a plan entering into force). Skipped parcels are not charged. Use with a schedule to monitor zoning.

stateKey.title: State key
stateKey.description: Name of the memory used by 'Only new or changed'. Use one key per watch list.

maxRequestsPerSecond.title: Max requests per second
maxRequestsPerSecond.description: Polite request rate towards each public service (ULDK and the planning register).

name: polish-healthcare-facilities-rpwdl
title: Poland Healthcare Facilities API – Official RPWDL Register
description: Polish hospitals, clinics and healthcare facilities (placówki medyczne) from the official RPWDL register: address, phone, organisation e-mail, website, NIP/REGON, specialties, beds. Medical leads by region, city or specialty. For AI agents (MCP). CSV, JSON, Excel.

voivodeships.title: Voivodeships
voivodeships.description: Only facilities in these voivodeships (regions). Empty = all of Poland.

terytCodes.title: Counties or communes (TERYT)
terytCodes.description: TERYT code prefixes: 4 digits for a county (e.g. 1465 = Warsaw, 1261 = Kraków), 6-7 digits for a commune. Combined with voivodeships: a facility in any listed area matches.

cities.title: Cities
cities.description: City or village names as in the address, e.g. Warszawa, Kraków. Case and Polish letters do not matter.

facilityKinds.title: Facility kind
facilityKinds.description: Kind of healthcare establishment. Empty = all.

ownership.title: Ownership
ownership.description: Public (SP ZOZ, budget units, research institutes, companies at least 51% public), private companies, non-profits or church entities. Empty = all.

specialtyCodes.title: Specialty codes
specialtyCodes.description: 4-digit ministry codes of cells (VIII part of the resort code), e.g. 1800 dental clinic, 4500 general surgery ward, 7210 ultrasound lab. A facility matches if any of its active cells has one.

specialtyKeywords.title: Specialty keywords (Polish)
specialtyKeywords.description: Words found in specialty or medical field names, in Polish, e.g. stomatolog, kardiolog, rehabilitac, okulist. A facility matches if any word appears.

nameContains.title: Name contains
nameContains.description: Text found in the facility, establishment or provider name, e.g. LUX MED or szpital.

nips.title: Provider NIPs
nips.description: Only facilities of providers with these tax IDs (10 digits).

onlyWithEmail.title: Only with e-mail
onlyWithEmail.description: Only facilities with an organisation e-mail address.

onlyWithPhone.title: Only with phone
onlyWithPhone.description: Only facilities with a phone number.

minBeds.title: Minimum beds
minBeds.description: Only facilities with at least this many beds (0 = no limit).

maxItems.title: Max facilities
maxItems.description: Stop after this many facilities, and so this many charged events. The whole register is about 24,000 facilities.

onlyNew.title: Only new or changed
onlyNew.description: Skip facilities delivered in an earlier run with the same state key and unchanged data. Use it for scheduled runs that report new and changed entries.

stateKey.title: State key
stateKey.description: Name of the memory used by 'Only new or changed'. Use one key per filter set.

name: polish-building-permits-gunb
title: Poland Building Permits API – Pozwolenia na budowę (GUNB)
description: Poland building permits (pozwolenia na budowę) and construction notifications from the official GUNB register (RWDZ): project, category, cubature, location, dates. Company investors named, private persons anonymised. Construction leads; AI agents (MCP). CSV, JSON, Excel.

registers.title: Registers
registers.description: PERMITS = building permit decisions (pozwolenia na budowę, with the investor where it is an organisation). NOTIFICATIONS = construction notifications without objection (zgłoszenia, whole country, no investor column). Empty = PERMITS.

voivodeships.title: Voivodeships
voivodeships.description: Regions to read. Not set = mazowieckie, so the first run is quick. Choose 'Whole country' for all 16. Ignored when TERYT codes are given.

terytCodes.title: Counties or communes (TERYT)
terytCodes.description: TERYT code prefixes: 2 digits for a voivodeship, 4 for a county (1465 = Warsaw, 1261 = Kraków, 3064 = Poznań, 0264 = Wrocław), 6-7 for a commune. When set, these replace the voivodeship list.

dateFrom.title: From date
dateFrom.description: Earliest decision date (permits) or application date (notifications).

dateTo.title: To date
dateTo.description: Latest decision date (permits) or application date (notifications).

daysBack.title: Last N days
daysBack.description: Only cases from the last N days (0 = no limit). Combined with 'From date', the later date wins.

enumTitles: III small buildings: summer houses, outbuildings, garages up to two spaces
IV road and railway elements: junctions, exits, platforms
V open-air sports and recreation facilities
IX culture, science and education buildings
XI healthcare and social care buildings
XV sports halls and indoor pools
XVII retail, food service and service buildings
XXI ports, marinas and other water transport structures
XXII storage yards, car parks, landfills
XXIV water management structures: reservoirs, fish ponds
XXVI networks: power, telecom, gas, heat, water, sewage, pipelines
XXIX chimneys, masts and wind turbine structures
XXX water intakes, pumping stations, treatment plants

investmentKinds.title: Investment kind
investmentKinds.description: Single-family house or anything else. Empty = both.

onlyWithInvestor.title: Only cases with a named investor
onlyWithInvestor.description: Only permits whose investor is a company, public body, church, non-profit or housing community (named, with address and plots). Cases of private individuals are never named.

investorTypes.title: Investor type
investorTypes.description: Only permits whose investor is of these types (implies a named investor). Empty = any.

enumTitles: Public body (state, local government, public institutions)

investorContains.title: Investor name contains
investorContains.description: Text in the investor name, e.g. 'Dom Development' or 'Gmina'. Case and Polish letters do not matter. Implies a named investor.

keywords.title: Keywords in project name
keywords.description: Any of these words in the project name, e.g. 'hala', 'magazyn', 'fotowolta'. Case and Polish letters do not matter.

minCubature.title: Minimum cubature (m³)
minCubature.description: Only projects at least this large (cubature as stated in the register; many entries have none).

maxItems.title: Max results
maxItems.description: Newest first. You pay per delivered result.

onlyNew.title: Only new or changed cases
onlyNew.description: Skip cases delivered by an earlier run with the same state key and unchanged since. Use with a schedule to get a daily feed of new permits.

stateKey.title: State key
stateKey.description: Name of the memory used by 'Only new or changed cases'. Use one key per monitored search.

name: polish-court-judgments-saos
title: Poland Court Judgments API – SAOS Case Law
description: Search Polish court judgments and case law (orzeczenia sądów) from the official SAOS API by court, date and phrase. Get case numbers, judges, keywords and optional published full text. For legal research and AI agents (MCP). CSV, JSON, Excel.

inputSchema.title: Polish Court Judgments Scraper – SAOS API input

courtType.title: Court type
courtType.description: ANY searches all available courts. Coverage checked 2026-10-18: COMMON about 474k judgments through 2026; SUPREME latest June 2016; Constitutional Tribunal December 2015; National Appeal Chamber September 2018; ADMINISTRATIVE no results. SAOS is incomplete and freshness varies.

commonCourtType.title: Common court subtype
commonCourtType.description: Optional. Requires courtType COMMON. Sent as ccCourtType.

dateFrom.title: Judgment date from
dateFrom.description: Inclusive start date, YYYY-MM-DD. Empty means no lower bound.

dateTo.title: Judgment date to
dateTo.description: Inclusive end date, YYYY-MM-DD. Empty means no upper bound.

phrase.title: Search phrase
phrase.description: Searches metadata and text using SAOS query language. Use double quotes for an exact phrase, for example "kredyt frankowy".

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Exact SAOS subject keywords. All supplied keywords must match (AND). Source keywords are available for common courts.

judgmentTypes.title: Judgment types
judgmentTypes.description: Include any selected judgment type (OR). Empty includes all types.

includeFullText.title: Include full text
includeFullText.description: Fetch individual judgment details. Successful text costs $0.01 per delivered judgment; metadata and text failures cost $0.003. Search snippets alone are not full text.

onlyWithText.title: Only judgments with a text snippet
onlyWithText.description: Skip empty search snippets before fetching details, saving rows, or charging. Defaults to true with includeFullText and false for metadata. Set false explicitly to include empty snippets. A nonempty snippet does not guarantee usable full text.

textFormat.title: Full text format
textFormat.description: Plain text preserves paragraphs and published anonymisation markers. HTML preserves source markup.

maxTextChars.title: Maximum text characters
maxTextChars.description: Full text character cap after formatting. Zero means unlimited. Capped HTML may end inside a tag. textLength reports the original formatted length.

sortOrder.title: Sort order
sortOrder.description: Sort by judgment date. The source may contain invalid or future dates.

skipInvalidDates.title: Skip invalid dates
skipInvalidDates.description: Skip malformed dates, years outside 1900–2100, and dates after the UTC scrape date. Skipped records are not charged.

maxItems.title: Maximum output items
maxItems.description: Hard cap on actual dataset rows. Skipped records do not count. Text filtering may require more search pages to fill this cap.

onlyNew.title: Only new IDs
onlyNew.description: Skip IDs retained in a named key-value store. Retains the most recent 50,000 delivered IDs. Does not detect edits. Avoid concurrent runs sharing stateKey.

stateKey.title: Seen state key
stateKey.description: Persistent ID set key. Use 1–100 letters, digits, underscores, or hyphens. Use different keys for independent feeds.

maxRequestsPerSecond.title: Maximum requests per second
maxRequestsPerSecond.description: Shared rate cap across search, details, and retries. Default 1 request/second; maximum 3. At most 2 requests in flight.
maxRequestsPerSecond.sectionDescription: Reduce the rate when the public source is under load.

name: polish-new-companies-krs
title: Poland New Companies API – KRS Registrations Feed
description: New and changed Polish companies every day from the official KRS register (nowe spółki KRS): name, NIP, REGON, address, PKD, share capital, registration date. No personal data. For leads, KYC, CRM and AI agents (MCP). CSV, JSON, Excel.

dateFrom.title: From date
dateFrom.description: First bulletin day (YYYY-MM-DD, Europe/Warsaw). Empty with dateTo empty means yesterday. One day when only dateFrom is set.

dateTo.title: To date
dateTo.description: Last bulletin day (inclusive). Must be used together with dateFrom. At most 31 days in the range.

events.title: Events
events.description: New = registration date in the window. Changed = appeared on the bulletin but registered earlier. Last-entry date does not reclassify.

pkd.title: PKD codes
pkd.description: Match full PKD codes or prefixes (e.g. 93 matches 93.29.B). Empty = any activity.

voivodeships.title: Voivodeships
voivodeships.description: Registered seat must be in one of these voivodeships. Empty = whole country.

legalForms.title: Legal forms
legalForms.description: Exact forma prawna strings after trimming. Empty = any form.

minShareCapital.title: Minimum share capital
minShareCapital.description: Companies without share capital fail this filter when set.

maxItems.title: Max companies
maxItems.description: Stop after this many companies are saved (default keeps Start runs cheap).
